role: per-candidate fields required by the registration

richest_fixed_state_asset.hash_is: plan hash only (e.g. 5c28be5a88095753) -- not an action identity

scalar_only_asset.note: scalar J per arm per state only: no plan, no mask, no action, no commit

source_level.finding: no installed / write_back / committed / P_after persistence exists in the F-arm online path (source-level check, not a substring probe of outputs)

per_candidate_executable_actions.what_exists_instead: a plan hash per candidate (e.g. 5c28be5a88095753) plus the C0 certificate reconciliation lists
per_candidate_executable_actions.why_not_substitutable: a plan hash identifies a plan, not the executable action identity the registration requires

true_committed_differences.what_exists_instead: pre-commit candidate evaluation (which candidate scored best), not what the online caller actually installed
true_committed_differences.why_not_substitutable: model scores and final routes are candidates; only a recorded post-install plan or accept/reject decision is commit evidence

consequence: the two fields are non-traceable from the existing assets; they must not be reconstructed or approximated, and a prospective collection would be a separate pre-registered study
